table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	itemname = service.name,
	reprintdate = getDate(),
	users.username,  
	dbo.serviceheader.serviceinvcode,
	doctor=(select name from doctors where doctors.doctcode=serviceheader.doctcode),   
	dbo.serviceheader.date,  
	dbo.serviceheader.headerno,
	dbo.serviceheader.discperc,   
	dbo.serviceheader.misccharges,   
	dbo.serviceheader.custcode,   
	dbo.serviceheader.remarks,
	dbo.serviceheader.flatdisc,
	reprintcounter = dbo.serviceheader.reprintingcounter,
	dbo.service.servicecode,   
	price = dbo.servicedetail.price,
	costprice=service.costprice, 
	serviceflatdisc=servicedetail.serviceflatdisc,
	Qty = dbo.servicedetail.qty,
	servicedetail_discperc = servicedetail.discperc, 
	customername=(SELECT Accounts.Name FROM Accounts WHERE Accounts.AccCode  = serviceheader.Custcode),
	patient.regno,
	patient=patient.name,
	patient_fname=patient.fname,
	patient_gender=(case patient.gender when 'F' then 'Female' When 'M' then 'Male' end),
	ageyears=patient.ageyears,
	agemonths=patient.agemonths,
	agedays=patient.agedays,
	pateintadd=patient.address1,
	patientadd2=patient.address2,
	patientmobile1=patient.mobileno1,
	headermobile=serviceheader.mobile,
	patientcnic=nationalidcard,
	patientrefby=serviceheader.patientrefby,
	serviceinvtypename=(select name from serviceinvtype where serviceinvtype.serviceinvtypecode=serviceheader.serviceinvtypecode),
	duedate=serviceheader.duedate,
    ref1=serviceheader.ref1,
	surgeryname=(select surgery.name from surgery where surgery.surgerycode=serviceheader.surgerycode),
	eyevisionname=(select eyevision.name from eyevision where eyevision.eyevisioncode=serviceheader.eyevisioncode),
	diseasename=(select disease.name from disease where disease.diseasecode=serviceheader.diseasecode),
	IOLPowername=(select iolpower.name from iolpower where iolpower.iolpowercode=serviceheader.iolpowercode),
	surgeryprocedure=(select surgeryprocedure.name from surgeryprocedure where surgeryprocedure.surgeryprocedurecode=serviceheader.surgeryprocedurecode),
	servicehederitem=serviceheader.item,
	dbo.serviceheader.saleinvcode,
	cashcharged=serviceheader.cashcharged,
	dbo.serviceheader.servicecatcode,
	tokenno = dbo.serviceheader.tokenno,
	serviceinvtotal=dbo.fn_getserviceinvtotal(:ra_InvCode)
	
FROM 
	dbo.serviceheader LEFT OUTER JOIN Patient ON (dbo.serviceheader.patientcode = patient.patientcode),   
	dbo.servicedetail,  
	service, 
	users
	
WHERE 
	( dbo.serviceheader.serviceinvcode = :ra_InvCode ) AND
	( dbo.serviceheader.serviceinvcode = dbo.servicedetail.serviceinvcode ) AND 
	( dbo.serviceheader.salesmancode = dbo.users.usercode ) AND
	( servicedetail.servicecode = service.servicecode )

objects.name: c_nettotal
objects.expression: /*Round(Sum (  c_netamount for all ) -  flatdisc +  serviceheader_misccharges   , 0)*/ serviceinvtotal

objects.name: c_totaldisc
objects.expression: (Sum (  c_amount  for all )  *    serviceheader_discperc  * .01)+ ( price - serviceflatdisc) *  qty *    (   servicedetail_discperc   * .01 )  +flatdisc+sum( serviceflatdisc for all)
